beat: Ambiguous towel request resolves as mangalsutra query, then new cliffhanger

lines.original: Bobby hated being put in a corner... but Dhika knew it was the only way to get him to open....but she didn't expect what she heard back...
lines.local: Bobby ko corner mein aana pasand nahi tha, lekin Dhika ko laga isi tarah woh khulega. Use agla jawaab sunne ki ummeed nahi thi.

lines.original: Bobby: miss.. please lower your towel a litte....
lines.local: Bobby: Miss, please apna towel zara neeche kariye.

lines.original: Dhika: what????.... Bobby I can't do that ... she jerked
lines.local: Dhika jhatke se: Kya? Bobby, main aisa nahi kar sakti!

lines.original: Bobby: oh...no... no miss.. I meant, a little so that I can see your mangalsutra...
lines.local: Bobby: Arre nahi, nahi miss, mera matlab bas itna ki main aapka mangalsutra dekh sakoon.

lines.original: Dhika: feeling a little relieved, oh, hehe... I got afraid for a second...
lines.local: Dhika ko thodi rahat mili: Oh, hehe! Main toh ek second ke liye darr gayi thi.

lines.original: Bobby: He got what she misunderstood as.... no miss... I wouldn't... he shyed again...
lines.local: Bobby samajh gaya usne kya galat matlab nikala: Nahi miss, main aisa nahi... Woh phir sharma gaya.

lines.original: Dhika: but Bobby dear... you have already seen it before... when... Blush ... when you saw me in bra before...
lines.local: Dhika: Par Bobby dear, tumne pehle bhi toh dekha hai... jab... jab tumne mujhe bra mein dekha tha. Woh blush hui.

lines.original: Bobby: yes miss. he blushed.... but I just wanted to see it again...to see how it looks against your skin....
lines.local: Bobby: Haan miss, lekin main phir dekhna chahta tha ki woh aapki skin par kaisa lagta hai.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... okay,.. but atleast let me wear a bra... it will be... easier... she blushed...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, achha, lekin kam se kam mujhe bra pehenne do; mere liye aasaan hoga. Woh sharmaayi.

lines.original: Bobby: quietly... can I decide if you can wear it or not after I see the bra miss.... he asked with great shyness
lines.local: Bobby bahut dheere se: Miss, kya main bra dekhne ke baad decide kar sakta hoon ki aap ise pehen sakti hain ya nahi?

lines.original: Dhika: while thinking... still she nodded yes... with a wink in one eye
lines.local: Dhika ne socha, phir ek aankh se wink karke haan mein sir hila diya.

lines.original: Bobby expected her to take and just show the bra in hand... but she felt naughty making him blush everytime... and now, she wanted to make him blush even more...
lines.local: Bobby ko ummeed thi ki Dhika bas bra haath mein lekar dikhaayegi, lekin woh har baar use blush karaane mein mazaa le rahi thi aur is baar use aur zyada sharmaana chahti thi.

lines.original: Bobby did turn blushing red looking at... what.... she.... did.... next..
lines.local: Bobby ne Dhika ka agla kaam dekha aur sharm se ekdam laal pad gaya... woh aage kya karne waali thi?
